notes: REF-BM-10: tags entered via plain text input; no autocomplete/suggestion of existing tags on entry (tag cloud is for filtering only). REF-BM-14: tag search implemented via `tag:name` syntax, not the specified `#tag` syntax; a `#foo` token falls through to plain text matching. REF-BM-15: only implicit AND and `-`/`-"..."` exclusion supported; no OR operator, no parenthesised groups, no word AND/NOT operators, and no quote-operators-as-literal rule (search.js tokenizer). REF-BM-21: bulk actions run on selected ids; select-all ticks only visible/loaded cards (capped at limit 500) with no dedicated 'apply to entire matching collection' affordance beyond the page. REF-BM-23: markdown notes are stored and editable but rendered as escaped plain text in cards (esc()), with no markdown-to-HTML rendering anywhere. REF-BM-24: snapshot saves a full-page screenshot plus page.content() HTML (not a self-contained single file with inlined resources) and has no PDF branch to download/store the PDF for PDF URLs. REF-BM-25: no Internet Archive / web.archive.org integration; snapshots are local only. REF-BM-32: preferences cover default sort, theme, view, density, show-previews and persist, but the named facets 'displayed items' and 'font size' are not implemented.
